notes: Dev account decommission. Four former collaborators (DEV-FIXER, DEV-SLUT, DEV-GURU, DEV-PEAK) hold plaintext dev credentials and no longer work on the project. Their accounts are retired rather than deleted: DELETE FROM players trips the non-cascading foreign keys on fund_proposals.proposer_id, fund_votes.player_id and funds.owner_id under PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON, and would orphan their trade and chat history. Instead every privilege is stripped and the login is sealed with a 64 byte random value in password_hash, which is a preimage nobody can produce, so no plaintext logs in. MrFlesh and DEV-SMASHER keep dev status with rotated credentials. THE NON-OBVIOUS PART: demotion alone would have PROMOTED the retired accounts. seed_devaccounts.mjs sets patreon_tier=3 on every dev, revokeExpiredPatreon() treats tier 3 as lifetime and never expires it, and syncFundMembership() auto-enrols anyone at tier>=2 into MERCHANTS_GUILD. Today the dev-exclusion sweep keeps them out. Clear is_dev without clearing the tier and that sweep stops matching, the patron sweep enrols them on the next tick, and they gain deposit, withdraw and proposal rights on the guild fund they do not have now. The retirement therefore zeroes patreon_tier, patreon_member_id and patreon_expires_at, drops the dev-only fleshstation faction and clears both fund memberships. seed_devaccounts.mjs is now idempotent and prints an audit line naming every account still carrying is_dev, is_admin or is_prime. SERVER SIDE. Requires .env update on the VPS plus a restart.
